item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3.12 -c 'from solution import patch_query
from urllib.parse import urlsplit, parse_qsl
cases = [
(\"components\", \"https://u:p@EXAMPLE.invalid:8443/a%2Fb?a=1#frag%20ment\", [(\"b\", \"2\")], [(\"a\", \"1\"), (\"b\", \"2\")]),
(\"unchanged duplicates and blanks\", \"/p?a=1&a=2&blank=&bare&z=3\", [], [(\"a\", \"1\"), (\"a\", \"2\"), (\"blank\", \"\"), (\"bare\", \"\"), (\"z\", \"3\")]),
(\"replacement moves to end\", \"/?a=1&b=2&a=3&c=4\", [(\"a\", \"5\")], [(\"b\", \"2\"), (\"c\", \"4\"), (\"a\", \"5\")]),
(\"empty value\", \"?a=1&b=2\", [(\"a\", \"\")], [(\"b\", \"2\"), (\"a\", \"\")]),
(\"literal encoding\", \"?old=1\", [(\"雪 +&%=\", \"café +&%=\")], [(\"old\", \"1\"), (\"雪 +&%=\", \"café +&%=\")]),
(\"decoded case sensitive keys\", \"?%61=1&A=2&a=3&x=4\", [(\"a\", \"new\")], [(\"A\", \"2\"), (\"x\", \"4\"), (\"a\", \"new\")]),
(\"repeated updates\", \"?a=1&b=2\", [(\"a\", \"x\"), (\"b\", None), (\"a\", None), (\"a\", \"last\"), (\"c\", \"\")], [(\"a\", \"last\"), (\"c\", \"\")]),
(\"relative\", \"../items?a=1#section\", [(\"b\", \"2\")], [(\"a\", \"1\"), (\"b\", \"2\")]),
(\"blank key\", \"?=1&a=2&=3\", [(\"\", \"\")], [(\"a\", \"2\"), (\"\", \"\")]),
(\"delete missing\", \"?a=1&a=2\", [(\"z\", None)], [(\"a\", \"1\"), (\"a\", \"2\")]),
]
for name, url, updates, expected in cases:
    before = list(updates)
    result = patch_query(url, updates)
    parts, original = urlsplit(result), urlsplit(url)
    assert parse_qsl(parts.query, keep_blank_values=True) == expected, (name, result)
    assert (parts.scheme, parts.netloc, parts.path, parts.fragment) == (original.scheme, original.netloc, original.path, original.fragment), name
    assert updates == before, name
encoded = patch_query(\"\", [(\"+&%=雪\", \"+&%=雪\")])
assert encoded == \"?%2B%26%25%3D%E9%9B%AA=%2B%26%25%3D%E9%9B%AA\", encoded
seen = []
def operations():
    for item in [(\"a\", \"\"), (\"b\", None), (\"c\", \"x+y\")]:
        seen.append(item)
        yield item
assert patch_query(\"?a=1&b=2#f\", operations()) == \"?a=&c=x%2By#f\"
assert len(seen) == 3
print(\"12 targeted checks passed (10 table cases, exact encoding, one-pass generator)\")'"
/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff -- solution.py && git status --short'
